_note: PROJECT DEFAULT scenario and action definitions for simulation. Effects are applied to the model's operating-state inputs; the production response is a MODEL ESTIMATE, not a guaranteed recovery. Lost hours are always re-derived from availability (lost = scheduled_hours x (1 - availability)) and split between downtime and maintenance in their existing proportion, matching the operating records.

NORMAL.description: Current operating state, no additional disruption.

HEAVY_RAIN.description: Monsoon-type week: >=150 mm rain, wet ground, slower haulage.

EQUIPMENT_DEGRADATION.description: Fleet availability falls 12 points (unplanned downtime rises accordingly).

COMBINED_DISRUPTION.description: Heavy rain, equipment degradation and blast delay together.

EQUIPMENT_RECOVERY.label: Equipment recovery (corrective maintenance / standby units): +8 points availability

SCHEDULE_ADJUSTMENT.label: Schedule adjustment (re-sequence benches, redeploy haul trucks)

BLAST_DRILL_DELAY_REDUCTION.label: Blast / drill delay reduction (pre-positioned explosives, drill scheduling)
